description: List the release notes of every release of a project after one version and up to another, oldest first. A release without notes is still listed, with notes null and a link to the release. Pre-releases are left out unless the last version is one.

from.description: list the releases after this version, written as a version or as a manifest names it (4.19.2 or ^4.19.2)

name.description: the project's name in that registry, from a search result's name

page.description: the page to return, starting at 1

registry.description: the registry id, from list_registries or a search result's registry

to.description: list the releases up to and including this version; the latest stable release when empty

name: list_project_release_notes
